title: Provisioning criteria -> entry -> recreate -> journal entry lifecycle
scenario: Create a provisioning criteria, create a provisioning entry, recreate it, then post its journal entry; the entry must be journalized and carry at least one loan-product provisioning row.
grade: Assert the criteria round-trips (name/products/definitions), and after recreate+createjournalentry the entry reports journalEntry=true with >0 rows.
